title: 第一卷 第10章 一顿早餐作为报酬
novel_title: 重回九八：我在小渔村兴风作浪
content_zh:
阿青笑道：“华哥，我都听你的。”

    李华开玩笑道：“你就这么相信我？不怕我把你带到沟里去？”

    阿青摇摇头：“我才不怕呢。”

    “我是跟着你的。”

    “就算是你要把我带沟里，也是你先掉沟里，我在后面。”

    “再说，你都掉沟里了，我说啥也得陪你。”

    李华：“……”

    谁说阿青傻的？分明是大智若愚啊！

    菜吃的干干净净，两个人喝了六瓶酒，看阿青还要开酒，李华说道：“菜都没了，别干喝了，今天就到这。”

    “回去就睡，明天一早还得去赶海。”

    阿青点头，俩人把菜吃的干干净净，也没啥好收拾的，他把酒瓶放到墙角，将空盘子拿走。

    阿青走后。

    李华往破竹席上一躺，感觉有些硌得慌，掀开竹席一看。

    下面有一堆零钱。

    拿起来数了数，一共是 83块5角7分。

    李华恍然。

    是阿青放的。

    这是阿青所有的钱。

    虽然上一世阿青的这些钱并没有帮到他什么，，但这份情谊却比什么都珍贵。

    他把钱捋平放好。

    现在是夏天，天黑得晚。

    别看刚天黑了没多久，其实已经8点多。

    接着酒劲儿，躺下来，没多久，呼噜声就响了起来。

    ……

    早晨。

    李华在睡梦中猛地翻身坐起来，擦了擦额头的汗水。

    这一夜，他做了很多的梦，每一个梦都无比清晰。

    上一世，他见过的人，经历的一些事情，如同走马观花一般，在梦里不断闪现。

    心脏狂跳。

    梦里梦外分不清，根本分不清。

    缓了会，看着老屋家徒四壁的光景，他才确定自己真的重生回来了。

    外面天色大亮。

    李华赶紧跳下床，走到外面，看太阳才刚刚升起来，松了一口气。

    时间还早。

    每天都有两次涨潮，两次退潮，潮起潮落也是有规律的，每天的潮起潮落都会比前一天推迟一个小时左右。

    从昨天涨潮的情况来看，今天早上是五点左右开始退潮。
content_en:
Ah Qing smiled and said, "Brother Hua, I will listen to you."

    Li Hua joked: "Do you believe me so much? Aren't you afraid that I will take you into a ditch?"

    Ah Qing shook his head: "I'm not afraid."

    "I'm following you."

    "Even if you want to take me into a ditch, you will fall into the ditch first, and I will follow."

    "Besides, you've fallen into the ditch, and I have to accompany you no matter what."

    Li Hua: "..."

    Who said A Qing was stupid? It's obvious that he is very wise and foolish!

    The food was all eaten, and the two of them drank six bottles of wine. Seeing that Ah Qing wanted to drink more, Li Hua said: "The food is gone, don't drink anymore, that's it for today."

    "Go back and sleep. We have to catch the sea tomorrow morning."

    Ah Qing nodded. The two of them ate all the food. There was nothing to clean up. He put the wine bottle in the corner and took away the empty plate.

    After Ah Qing left.

    Li Hua lay down on the broken bamboo mat. Feeling a little nervous, he opened the bamboo mat and took a look.

    There is a pile of change below.

    I picked it up and counted it. It was 83 yuan, 50 cents and 7 cents in total.

    Li Hua suddenly realized.

    It was Ah Qing who released it.

    This is all the money Ah Qing has.

    Although the money from Ah Qing in his previous life did not help him, this friendship was more precious than anything else.

    He flattened the money and put it away.

    It's summer and it gets dark late.

    Despite the fact that it had just gotten dark, it was actually already past 8 o'clock.

    Then he got drunk and lay down. Not long after, he started snoring.

    ……

    morning.

    Li Hua suddenly turned over and sat up in his sleep, wiping the sweat from his forehead.

    That night, he had a lot of dreams, and every dream was extremely clear.

    In the last life, the people he met and some of the things he experienced kept flashing through his dreams like a fleeting glimpse of flowers.

    Heart pounding.

    It's hard to tell the difference between a dream and a dream, not at all.

    After calming down for a while and looking at the bare walls of his old house, he was sure that he was really reborn.

    It's bright outside.

    Li Hua quickly jumped out of bed and walked outside. He saw that the sun had just risen and breathed a sigh of relief.

    It's still early.

    There are two high tides and two low tides every day. The ebb and flow of the tides are also regular. Each day's ebb and flow will be about an hour later than the previous day.

    Judging from the high tide yesterday, the tide started to recede around five o'clock this morning.
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 10 A Breakfast as Reward
